question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Destroy
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e., **Ruin**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Destroy"** means to put an end to the existence of something by damaging or attacking it beyond repair. (नष्ट करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The heavy rains destroyed the crops in the fields.
 
 
 
• **"Ruin"** refers to causing great and irreparable damage or harm to something. It is synonymous with "destroy." (बर्बाद करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The earthquake ruined several buildings in the city.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Destroy' **is **'Ruin'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Delight **(आनंद): A feeling of great pleasure or happiness.

 
 
• **Example: **She was filled with delight when she received the good news.
 
 
 
• **Decline **(अस्वीकार या गिरावट): To become smaller, fewer, or less; decrease.
 
 
• **Example: **There has been a decline in the number of visitors to the museum.
 
 
 
• **Fabricate **(गढ़ना): To invent or concoct something, typically with deceitful intent.
 
 
• **Example: **He fabricated an excuse to avoid attending the meeting.
